    Rational linear functionals positive on prescribed real numbers #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_rat_linear_pos_on_finset (s : Finset ℝ) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < x) :
    ∃ (f : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ), ∀ x ∈ s, 0 < f x

    A rational-linear functional from ℝ to ℚ can preserve strict positivity on any prescribed finite list of positive real numbers.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_rat_linear_nonneg_pair {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ∃ (f : ℝ →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ), 0 < f 1 ∧ 0 ≤ f a ∧ 0 ≤ f b

    Two nonnegative real coefficients can be sent to nonnegative rational coefficients by a rational-linear functional that is positive on 1.
